changes._source: case study PDF page 9. Item 3 reworded without '90 degrees'; Mehedi approved 11 Nov 2026.
changes.heading: Fixed, not reinvented.
items: Corners and curves now match each other across the whole mark.
Every line of text is centred, with even space around it.
Angles are now square, so the mark stays simple to read and to reproduce.
A gap between two letters was corrected where they read as one shape.
